changes: Storage schema 6 flattens per-trial IntermediateValues snapshots into TrialIntermediateSnapshots; public TrialTable is reconstructed at load.
Original per-trial timestamps and order are preserved separately from IntermediateTable timestamps.
Unchanged AutoSave frequency, native-cache eligibility, primary read-back validation, atomic replacement, and verified backup.

notes: Scalar TPE, one float, completed trials, no callbacks.
ask includes sampler preparation and native computation; suggest includes recording.
MEX profile time includes gateway and native work, not separately measured transfer.
save includes complete MAT serialization, read-back validation, and replacement/backup.
Profiling runs are separate from uninstrumented wall timings.

limitations: One scalar one-float completed-trial workload; seven samples, first two discarded per level.
Baseline and candidate ran on the same host at different times, not interleaved. Do not generalize the ratio to all persisted workloads.
Many nonempty snapshots were not performance-benchmarked; small nonempty/empty/RUNNING roundtrip correctness was tested.
This is full-save latency, not end-to-end optimization throughput or a Rustuna comparison.
